name: PVI Manufacturing, LLC
old_description: is the leading global manufacturer of multifold aluminum wheelchair ramps and the premier designer of food service equipment in the US. We strive to have the highest quality equipment in both stainless steel and aluminum and the best customer service.
about:
PVI Manufacturing, LLC was founded in 1991 in Prairie View, Kansas, with a mission to design and manufacture high-quality, all-aluminum products that make a meaningful difference in people's lives. Today the company operates from a nearly 200,000-square-foot facility in Fairbury, Nebraska, as a wholly owned subsidiary of Dutton-Lainson Company, a family-owned business headquartered in Hastings, Nebraska, since 1886.

The company manufactures multifold aluminum wheelchair ramps — tested to a 3X safety factor — and designs food service equipment in both stainless steel and aluminum, along with toy hauler accessories such as storage cabinets and fuel jug holders. With 100-plus employees, PVI offers custom fabrication supported by 3-D modeling and CAD capabilities, holds NSF certification for its food service line, and stocks over 95 percent of its product catalog for rapid fulfillment.

PVI serves the mobility and rehabilitation market, supplying ramps to individuals, durable medical equipment providers like Superior Mobility, and dealers nationwide. Its food service division equips restaurants such as John's Pizza Café in St. Paul, Minnesota, and institutions like Freestate School in Lawrence, Kansas. The toy hauler line targets recreational vehicle owners and garage organizers.

The company emphasizes its founding purpose of helping mobility-challenged people lead more active, productive lives, and its willingness to listen and build to customer needs. A central U.S. location enables 3- to 4-day delivery to either coast, and standard stock items ship same day or next business day, while custom orders typically require 8 to 10 business days.
